title: Wrong Finish - received shiny black finish
text: Wrong Finish - received shiny black finish. Nice lantern but finish does not match photos. The item I received has a shiny black finish that does blend with my decor as well as the metal finish pictured would have. Disappointed but not surprised by this discrepancy. Typical for Amazon. Photos and descriptions rarely match items shipped. It would cost me more to send it back than to just accept the loss. I recommend World Market for this type of item instead of Amazon.
